items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So he invited me out to the PBS special they had honoring Benny Goodman... I think we had Red Norvo. Norvo was playing the vibes, and my favorite, Jo Jones, playing drums.

ctx.x: Man, that was an incredible – Creed Taylor had been trying to convince Benny Goodman that I was the second Charlie Christian. I mean, I don’t believe that, but he thought that I was a close second to Charlie. So he invited me out to the PBS special they had honoring Benny Goodman, and they tried to put together a band that was similar, or some of the guys from his alumni – alumni from his other band. I think we had Red Norvo. Norvo was playing the vibes, and my favorite, Jo Jones, playing drums.
